acceptance: power_warmup_iterations=0 either runs no warm-up pass and records 0, or is refused with an error naming the minimum
A test covers the chosen behaviour
context: Found by an independent review of the site page docs/platforms/snowflake-gateways.md against core v0.5.1 (91d357a); each claim was re-verified by a second reviewer.
description: run_service.py:155-158 and runner.py:932-935 use `or` on the configured value, so power_warmup_iterations=0 becomes 1 and a user cannot ask for a power run without a warm-up pass. Either honour 0 or reject it with a clear message; silently changing the value misstates the run.
